Galicia (Galicia) — Spanien Reiseführer: Sehenswürdigkeiten, Anreise & Spezialitäten

Santiago de Compostela Cathedral & Old Town, Rías Baixas & Cíes Islands, A Coruña Tower of Hercules, Lugo Roman Walls & Ribeira Sacra canyon. AVE high-speed rail from Madrid to Ourense and Santiago de Compostela (~3h15); Santiago (SCQ), Vigo & A Coruña airports.

Region / KantonGalicia (Galicia)
VerkehrsknotenpunktSantiago de Compostela Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)
Alle Städte313

Anreise & Nahverkehr

AVE high-speed rail from Madrid to Ourense and Santiago de Compostela (~3h15); Santiago (SCQ), Vigo & A Coruña airports.

Lokale Küche & Spezialitäten

  • Pulpo a la gallega (Polbo á feira)
  • Percebes, Zamburiñas & Galician seafood
  • Empanada Gallega
  • Tarta de Santiago
  • Albariño (Rías Baixas) wine
